title: [main] bug 640380 - Add Word layout and email body support for Purchase Quote and Sales Shipment
summary: Word layouts and email body support have been added for Purchase Quote and Sales Shipment reports in the Czech localization, enabling these documents to be sent via email.
key_points: Purchase Quote and Sales Shipment reports now have Word layouts
Email body support added for both documents
New .docx email template files created for each report
Report definitions updated to include layout configurations
Czech localization package extended with email capabilities
quote: The word layouts and email body support has been added for purchase quote and sales shipment reports.
